title: Web Scraper & Content Indexing
description: Scrape web content and index it for intelligent querying and retrieval

web_scraper_scrape_and_index.title: Scrape & Index Content
web_scraper_scrape_and_index.description: Scrape content from web URLs and index it into a searchable vector store for later retrieval. Supports multiple URLs, customizable chunking, and persistent storage.

web_scraper_query_indexed_content.title: Query Indexed Content
web_scraper_query_indexed_content.description: Search and retrieve relevant information from previously indexed web content using semantic similarity. Perfect for answering questions based on scraped documents.

web_scraper_website_indexer.title: Complete Website Indexer
web_scraper_website_indexer.description: Index entire websites by discovering and scraping all pages using sitemaps. Automatically finds sitemaps from robots.txt, extracts all URLs, and comprehensively indexes website content.

web_scraper_document_indexer.title: Document Content Indexer
web_scraper_document_indexer.description: Import and index document content directly to the vector database. Perfect for adding content from Google Docs, Notion pages, PDFs, or any other document sources by copy-pasting.
